pages.text: $(bold)SlashBlade$()$(br2)How to obtain: build it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() - $(bold)sheath + blade + tough handle$().$(br2)The sheath and the blade are new parts added by this mod: make them at the Part Builder with their patterns, or cast them from molten metal (the gold cast is reusable, the sand and red sand casts are single use).$(br2)Stats: the blade is the primary part - 4.0 attack, 1.6 attack speed, 200 base durability.

$(bold)SlashBlade integration$()$(br2)With SlashBlade: Resharped installed, this tool hooks into it: the blade state (proud soul, kill count, refine, combo sequence and special arts) is carried on the blade.$(br2)Current progress: the tool and its parts are usable; $(bold)drawing, Iai, combos and special arts$() are still being implemented.
